  3. Education & human capital

22 engagements

In education and human capital, HAYKALAH’s published record starts with a flexible-work platform it built.

Education and human capital account for 22 of the 650+ engagements in HAYKALAH’s archive census, 2004–2026. The case cleared for publication is AS3A, a platform that matches flexible and part-time Saudi workers with employers, which HAYKALAH built and which is operating. Education cases are added as clients consent.

Archive census counts are indicative.

What we do

  • Validation of education and workforce ventures: market research, a feasibility study and HOAM screening.

  • Company formation, sector approvals and Saudization planning.

  • Business plans and operating models.

  • Capital readiness: model, valuation, due diligence and data room.

  • Equity-for-build co-founder terms.

How we create value

  • 03

    Optimization

    Before an education or workforce venture is formed, HAYKALAH tests demand and economics with market research, a feasibility study and HOAM screening.

  • 06

    Commercialization

    AS3A took a flexible-work model to market as an operating platform, with HAYKALAH as founder-builder and signed client agreements.

Questions

What education and human-capital work can HAYKALAH show?

The case cleared for publication is AS3A, a flexible-work platform that HAYKALAH built and that is operating. The census counts 22 engagements in the sector; others are shown as clients consent.

How does HAYKALAH build an education or workforce venture?

Through the same steps as any venture build: screening with HOAM, validation, company formation and sector approvals, capital readiness, and equity that vests at agreed gates.

Bring the idea, the institution or the program. We can start under an NDA.
